*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakerfinish-action)*

finish.docs: This action will stop playing audio data from the speaker after all data **is** played.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker to control. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakermute_off-action)*

mute_off.docs: This action will unmute the speaker.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker to control. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakermute_on-action)*

mute_on.docs: This action will mute the speaker.

data.docs:
**list of bytes**: The raw audio data to play.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakerplay-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker to control. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakerplay-action)*

play.docs: This action will start playing raw audio data from the speaker.

stop.docs: This action will stop playing audio data from the speaker and discard the unplayed data.

volume_set.docs: This action will set the volume of the speaker.

mixer.docs:
The `mixer` speaker platform allows you to mix audio sent to different source speakers into one output which is sent to another [speaker component](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/). Individual source speakers may be ducked (made quieter) with the [apply ducking action](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#mixer_speaker-apply_ducking).

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer)*

resampler.docs:
The `resampler` speaker platform allows you to convert the sample rate of an audio stream and output it to another [speaker component](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/).

*See also: [Resampler Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/resampler)*

router.docs:
The `router` speaker platform allows you to switch which [speaker component](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) receives audio at runtime. The router acts as a single speaker that an audio producer (such as a [media player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/) or a [mixer speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer/)) sends audio to, and it forwards that audio to whichever output speaker is currently active. Use the [switch output action](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router#router_speaker-switch_output) to change the active output while audio is playing, for example to move playback between an I²S speaker and an [SPDIF](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/i2s_audio/#spdif-mode) output.

*See also: [Router Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker to check. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakeris_playing-condition)*

is_playing.docs: This condition will check if the speaker is currently playing audio data.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker to check. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakeris_stopped-condition)*

is_stopped.docs: This condition will check if the speaker is fully stopped audio data and is in idle mode.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker to control. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#speakerstop-action)*

audio_dac.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [audio DAC](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/) to use for volume control.

*See also: [Speaker Components](https://esphome.io/components/speaker#base-speaker-configuration)*

sample_rate.docs:
**positive integer**: Sample rate to convert to. Must be between `8000` and `48000`. Defaults to the output speaker's sample rate.

*See also: [Resampler Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/resampler#configuration-variables)*

announcement.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to play back the file as an announcement or media stream. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#media_playerspeakerplay_on_device_media_file-action)*

enqueue.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to add the media file to the end of the pipeline's internal playlist. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#media_playerspeakerplay_on_device_media_file-action)*

media_file.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the media file.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#media_playerspeakerplay_on_device_media_file-action)*

play_on_device_media_file.docs: This action will play a on-device media file.

announcement_pipeline.docs:
**Pipeline Schema**: Configuration settings for the announcement pipeline.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

buffer_size.docs:
**positive integer**: The buffer size in bytes for each pipeline. Must be between `4000` and `4000000`. Defaults to `1000000`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

files.docs:
**list**: A list of media files to build into the firmware for on-device playback.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

media_pipeline.docs:
**Pipeline Schema**: Configuration settings for the media pipeline. Same options as the `announcement_pipeline`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

on_mute.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when muted.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

on_unmute.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when unmuted.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

on_volume.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the volume is changed.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

task_stack_in_psram.docs:
**boolean**: Run the audio tasks in external memory. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

volume_increment.docs:
**percentage**: Increment amount that the `media_player.volume_up` and `media_player.volume_down` actions will increase or decrease volume by. Defaults to `5%`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

volume_initial.docs:
**percentage**: The default volume that mediaplayer uses for first boot where a volume has not been previously saved. Defaults to `50%`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

volume_max.docs:
**percentage**: The maximum volume allowed. Defaults to `100%`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

volume_min.docs:
**percentage**: The minimum volume allowed. Defaults to `0%`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

format.docs:
**enum**: The audio format Home Assistant will transcode audio to before sending it to the device. One of `FLAC`, `MP3`, `OPUS`, `WAV`, or `NONE`. `NONE` disables transcoding in Home Assistant; ESPHome will then compile support for all supported codecs (`FLAC`, `MP3`, `OPUS`, and `WAV`), which increases firmware size. To compile in additional codecs without setting this to `NONE`, use the [Audio](https://esphome.io/components/audio/) component. Defaults to `FLAC`.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

num_channels.docs:
**positive integer**: Number of channels for the transcoded audio. Must be either `1` or `2`. Defaults to the speaker's number of channels.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

sample_rate.docs:
**positive integer**: Sample rate for the transcoded audio. Should be supported by the configured `speaker` component. Defaults to the speaker's sample rate. The `OPUS` codec only supports a `48000` sample rate.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*

speaker.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) to output the audio.

*See also: [Speaker Audio Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker#configuration-variables)*
